desc: Deactivate a user from an enterprise organization and all its workspaces.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

user_id.desc: The ID of the user to deactivate.

restricted_action.desc: The caller does not have permission to perform this action. Must be an org admin or owner.

user_not_found.desc: The user was not found or does not belong to this enterprise.

invalid_user.desc: The user was not found or is not a valid target for deactivation.

user_is_team_primary_owner.desc: The user is a primary owner of one or more workspaces and cannot be deactivated.
